Pairs on Aggregates

I. Summary Chapter on Terms (Pan. n. attivāra Uddesa)

(There are) five aggregates: matter aggregate, feeling aggregate, 1. perception aggregate, mental formations aggregate and consciousness aggregate.

1. Chapter on Purification of Words Padasodhanavāra

Positive (Anuloma)

(i) (It is) rūpa. (Is it) matter aggregate? (It is) matter aggregate. (Is 2. it) rūpa? (ii) Feeling. Feeling aggregate? Feeling aggregate. Feeling? (iii) Perception, Perception aggregate? Perception aggregate. Perception? (iv) Mental formations. Mental formation aggregate? Mental formation aggregate. Mental formations? (v) Consciousness. Consciousness aggregate? Consciousness aggregate. Consciousness?

Negative (Paccanīka)
